tests.name: Effective description
tests.reasoning: The description begins with imperative phrasing ('Use this skill for...'), lists extensive explicit trigger symptoms/contexts (avails not filling, VAST failures, timeouts, playback error codes, channel assembly symptoms), and clarifies scope boundaries with handoffs to related skills. It is somewhat long but remains a single focused paragraph covering a complex domain with many distinct symptom triggers, which is appropriate given the skill's breadth.
tests.evidence: Use this skill for AWS Elemental MediaTailor SSAI (server-side ad insertion) and Channel Assembly. Use for ad symptoms: avails not filling, slate or source content instead of ads, empty VAST/VMAP, ADS timeouts or errors...

tests.name: Verbosity and conciseness
tests.reasoning: The body avoids explaining general concepts (e.g., what HTTP status codes are, what CDNs are) and instead focuses entirely on MediaTailor-specific facts, field names, API calls, and non-obvious defaults the agent would not otherwise know.
tests.evidence: CloudWatch metrics are always published... CloudWatch logs are largely off by default and, for SSAI, sampled and filterable.

tests.name: Detailed reference materials must not be in body
tests.reasoning: The body keeps detailed reference data (metric formulas, error tables, log field catalogs) out of the main text, consistently pointing to references/ files for the heavy material, even inside conditional branches like the symptom-routing table and Step S1/S2/S3/S4 sections.
tests.evidence: The full metric catalog, the simple-vs-weighted fill-rate formulas, render rate and video completion rate, and good/bad guidance live in [references/ssai-metric-reference.md]

tests.name: Reference files must be linked
tests.reasoning: Every file in references/ is linked via markdown link syntax in the body: ssai-log-catalog.md, lookup-tables.md, ssai-fill-behavior.md, ssai-metric-reference.md, playback-errors-and-limits.md, channel-assembly-procedure.md, report-outlines.md, channel-assembly-checklist.md all appear as markdown links.

tests.name: Reference links must specify when to load
tests.reasoning: Each reference link is attached to a specific triggering condition or step, e.g., loading log catalog when checking observability gates, or metric reference during Step S2 fill rate analysis.
tests.evidence: load the "Observability preconditions" section of [references/ssai-log-catalog.md](references/ssai-log-catalog.md) when you need the exact field, default, cap or documented trap

tests.name: Reference path format
tests.reasoning: All reference links use relative paths rooted at references/ with no absolute paths or traversal.

tests.name: Prescription vs description
tests.reasoning: Fragile operations (log precheck gating, CLI commands, AWS API calls) are given exact prescriptive commands, while interpretive work (routing symptoms, drafting findings) is described with rationale and flexibility, matching prescriptiveness to fragility.
tests.evidence: Omit `--max-results` and all pagination flags so the SDK auto-paginates; passing caps causes errors and `--no-paginate` returns only one page.

tests.name: Defaults, not menus
tests.reasoning: Where multiple logging strategies or query options exist, the skill designates defaults/starting points (e.g., 'Highest-value starting queries') rather than presenting equal menus.
tests.evidence: Highest-value starting queries (full set in the reference file): Event-type histogram (`stats count(*) by eventType`) to see the shape of the problem before drilling in.

tests.name: Favor procedures over declarations
tests.reasoning: The skill teaches a generalizable investigative method (symptom routing table, step-by-step diagnostic branches) applicable to any MediaTailor incident, not a one-off instance-specific task.
tests.evidence: Then map the symptom to where the answer usually lives. Start at "First stop"; escalate only if it does not explain the symptom.

tests.name: Gotchas section
tests.reasoning: The skill has an extensive de facto gotchas treatment throughout (observability defaults, CDN caching traps, metric casing traps, schema bugs) even without a single section titled 'Gotchas'.
tests.evidence: notably that a `VAST_RESPONSE` event may carry no `vastResponse` object on empty responses

tests.name: Templates and outputs missing
tests.reasoning: The skill does provide an explicit output structure guidance for findings and points to report-outlines.md for the full templates, satisfying the need for structured output without inlining a large template.
tests.evidence: Use the matching report outline (SSAI or Channel Assembly) in [references/report-outlines.md](references/report-outlines.md) when compiling the report; load it at this step only.

tests.name: Templates and outputs must not be in body
tests.reasoning: The inline 'Step F: Compile findings' template describing Observed/Expected/Question/confidence tag is short (well under 20 lines) and the larger templates live in references/report-outlines.md.
tests.evidence: Observed (the metric/log/config value plus the API or namespace it came from... Expected (the threshold or benchmark plus its source), Question: Why?, and a confidence tag...
